blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 201,000 domestic workers in the Calabarzon region will receive a P750 monthly wage increase starting Oct. 26, raising their minimum monthly pay to P7,500 under a new wage order. The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) in Region IV-A issued Wage Order No. RB-IVA-DW-06, which covers domestic workers in Batangas, Cavite, Laguna, Quezon and Rizal, the wage board said on Oct. 10. The new rate raises the minimum monthly wage for domestic workers from P6,750 to P7,500.
